title: Badge colors use the canonical payment-status tokens in light and dark
refs: SV-8625 (SBR spec v22 2026-08-17 Story 8 S8-R3; Story 18 S18-R8)
preconds: 1. Detail rows with all three badge values are visible; you can switch to dark mode.
steps:
1. Read the color treatment of each badge in light mode and compare with the badges on the application's invoice list.

expected:

3. The treatment stays legible and consistent in both light and dark mode.
